svg.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Top: sum and delta beam levels from minus 20 to plus 20 degrees at 10.0 GHz; the sum is flat at its peak while the delta passes through a zero on the target. Bottom: the error the GUI plots, the delta over sum ratio signed by side, zero on the target, close to a straight line of slope 0.10 per degree near it, clamped at plus and minus 1, and flipping sign past the sum beam's first nulls.
